query: Create an HD wallet with Ethereum and Solana addresses
expected_behavior: Checks for existing wallets using getWallets before creating
Uses @turnkey/sdk-server to call createWallet
Includes CURVE_SECP256K1 with ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM for Ethereum
Includes CURVE_ED25519 with ADDRESS_FORMAT_SOLANA for Solana
Uses standard BIP-44 derivation paths

query: Get the Ethereum address from my existing wallet
expected_behavior: Calls getWallets to find existing wallets
Calls getWalletAccounts to list addresses
Filters for ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM
Does NOT create a new wallet

query: I need a Bitcoin testnet address, create a wallet for me right away
expected_behavior: Still checks getWallets first despite user urgency
Uses ADDRESS_FORMAT_BITCOIN_TESTNET_P2WPKH for testnet
Uses the correct BIP-84 path m/84'/0'/0'/0/0

query: Add a Cosmos address to my existing wallet
expected_behavior: Uses createWalletAccounts (not createWallet) to add to existing wallet
Uses CURVE_SECP256K1 with ADDRESS_FORMAT_COSMOS
Uses the correct derivation path m/44'/118'/0'/0/0

query: Set up wallets for my end users, each user should have their own Ethereum wallet
expected_behavior: Recommends sub-organization model (one sub-org per user)
Uses createSubOrganization with wallet parameter
Includes rootUsers configuration
Uses ADDRESS_FORMAT_ETHEREUM for the wallet accounts

query: Create a wallet with a TON and XRP address
expected_behavior: Checks for existing wallets first
Uses CURVE_ED25519 with ADDRESS_FORMAT_TON_V4R2 for TON
Uses CURVE_SECP256K1 with ADDRESS_FORMAT_XRP for XRP
Uses correct derivation paths for both chains
